description: Remaining COUNCIL-level secondary reports (the 6 council reports other than council-schools-rank-subjectwise). Each is its own self-contained report unit (own template.html.j2, style.css, data.json, reference/original.pdf, output/). Templates named by LEVEL + FUNCTION only (never the council instance name 'MWANZA CC', which is just the test council). Reuse the shared fonts.css and grading.py; reuse a prior report's template only when the structure is genuinely the same.
steps: council-subjects-rank  <- 'MWANZA CC SUBJECTS RANK.pdf' (2pp, landscape). One row per subject: S/NO., SUBJECT NAME, A,B,C,D,F, TOTAL, A-C,%A-C,A-D,%A-D, GPA, COMPETENCY LEVEL, RANK. Header ...'MWANZA CC ALL SUBJECTS PERFOMANCE' (preserve the original spelling). This is close to the subjectwise-rank column set but rows are subjects, not schools; build its own template.

council-schools-rank-overall  <- 'MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK.pdf' (1pp, landscape). Division-performance grid: S/NO., WARD, SCHOOL NAME, OWNERSHIP, then NUMBER OF CANDIDATES (REGISTERED, SAT with F/M/T/% ) and DIVISION PERFORMANCE (I,II,III,IV,0 each F/M/T, plus I-III, I-IV with F/M/T/%), GPA, COMPETENCY LEVEL, C/RANK and R/RANK. Includes a top summary row and a '% PASS' row. Build a landscape template with the F/M/T triplet grid.

council-top-10-schools  <- 'MWANZA CC 10 BEST SCHOOLS.pdf' (3pp, landscape). Multiple stacked sections (TOP TEN BEST SCHOOLS OVERALL COUNCILWISE, TOP TEN BEST GOVERNMENT SCHOOLS DISTRICTWISE, and any further sections on later pages). Division grid similar to schools-rank-overall but limited to 10 rows per section. Capture every section on every page.

council-best-students-overall  <- 'MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS.pdf' (5pp, landscape). Per-candidate rows: C/NO, SCHOOL NAME, CANDIDATE FULL NAME, SEX, points/GPA/DIV, POSITION, and a free-text DETAILED SUBJECTS column listing 'SUBJ - NN\'G\'' entries. Preserve the detailed-subjects string exactly.

council-best-students-subjectwise  <- 'MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS SUBJECTWISE.pdf' (30pp, landscape). One section per subject, each a top-10 table: S/NO., ID NO., SCHOOL, CATEGORY, CANDIDATE FULL NAME, SEX, MARKS, GRADE, POSITION, COMPETENCY LEVEL. Header per section 'TOP TEN BEST STUDENTS IN <SUBJECT> SUBJECT DISTRICTWISE'. Capture all subjects/pages.

council-wards-rank  <- 'MWANZA CC Wards Rank.pdf' (1pp, landscape). Ward performance: a summary block + per-ward rows S/NO., WARD, NUMBER OF SCHOOLS, candidates (REG, SAT TOTAL/%), division perf (I,II,III,I-III,IV,I-IV, DIV-0) each TOTAL/%, GPA, COMPETENCY LEVEL, RANK. Header 'MWANZA CC WARDS PERFORMANCE'.

For EACH of the above: create reports/secondary/council/<name>/ with template.html.j2, style.css (reference shared fonts.css, single family name, no fallbacks), data.json extracted as DISPLAY STRINGS using pdfplumber/pymupdf across ALL pages, reference/original.pdf copied from the corresponding council_pdf file, then render and compare, iterating until word-diff is at/near zero and pixel-diff is low.

Reuse grading.py for any competency-level colouring. Keep fixed fills in each report's CSS. Where a report shares a column structure with an already-built one, COPY that report's template+CSS as the starting point (do NOT @import or reference a shared stylesheet). USER RULE (strict): every PDF is FULLY self-contained - its own template.html.j2 AND its own style.css with INLINE @font-face (single family name, no fallback), NO shared stylesheet dependency. The ONLY custom/data-driven colour is the COMPETENCY LEVEL background; every other colour/fill/geometry is a fixed identical palette expressed in HTML+CSS+Jinja2. Sharing 'structure' means copying the shape as a starting point, not linking to a common file.
acceptance_criteria: All 6 council report directories exist under reports/secondary/council/ with the 4 required files each plus generated output/.
Each data.json captures every page/section/row of its source PDF as display strings (counts and values match text extraction).
Each generated PDF has the same page count as its original and renders without error.
For each report, compare.py shows near-zero missing/extra words and low pixel-diff, per page.
No template or directory is named after the council instance 'MWANZA CC'; names are level+function.
verification: For each of the 6 reports, run render + compare.py against its reference/original.pdf and confirm near-zero word-diff and low pixel-diff on every page.
Confirm each report's PDF page count equals its original's page count.
Spot-check that data.json values match the original PDF text (e.g. diff a sample of extracted rows against pdfplumber output).
findings:
All 6 remaining COUNCIL reports built as fully self-contained units under reports/secondary/council/<name>/ (each: own template.html.j2, own style.css with INLINE @font-face - single 'Arial'/'Arial Narrow' family name, NO fallback, NO shared stylesheet - own data.json extracted via pymupdf coordinate parsing (never hand-typed), reference/original.pdf, generated output/). Named by LEVEL+FUNCTION only (no 'MWANZA CC' in any dir/template name; it appears ONLY in data.json values). Competency-level background is the only data-driven colour (via grading.py; for best-students-subjectwise it is keyed off the single-letter GRADE column, others off the 'Grade X (...)' label / GPA). All other fills are a fixed :root palette. Every generated PDF embeds the REAL Arial-family faces (pymupdf get_fonts shows 'Arial'/'Arial-Bold', NOT Noto). Lakezone regression check: still renders 11 pages unchanged. render.py extended (backward-compatible) to decorate a flat top-level 'rows'+'overall' model and a 'sections' model (grade-letter -> competency level).

Extraction scripts (all pymupdf, coordinate/positional, 0 empty cells verified): extract_council_subjects_rank.py, extract_council_wards_rank.py, extract_council_schools_rank_overall.py, extract_council_best_students_overall.py, extract_council_best_students_subjectwise.py, extract_council_top_10_schools.py.

Per-report result (page count EXACT match to original in every case; residual pixel-diff is Liberation-vs-Arial glyph-edge noise, per FEAT-001 no genuine Monotype Arial obtainable in-sandbox; word-diff below is by EXACT Counter match, i.e. true content diff - the higher numbers compare.py prints are its fuzzy tokeniser splitting vertical/rotated headers like RANK/COMPETENCY/S-NO and are visual-identical artifacts):
- council-subjects-rank (2pp): p1 0 word-diff (compare.py shows 4/1 = vertical RANK header artifact) pixel ~19%; p2 0/0 pixel ~4%. One row per subject, GRADE PERFORMANCE super-header, 2x2 OVERALL block at bottom. Header 'MWANZA CC ALL SUBJECTS PERFOMANCE' (original misspelling preserved).
- council-wards-rank (1pp): 4 true word-miss (all vertical 'SUMMARY PERFORMANCE'/'SCHOOLS'/'COUNCIL' rotated-text tokenisation) pixel ~18%. Summary block + %PASS row + 18 ward rows + TOTAL row; I-III green / I-IV blue / DIV-0 peach fills; RANK column.
- council-schools-rank-overall (1pp): 9 true word-miss on p1 (SUMMARY/COMPETENCY/LEVEL rotated + a couple long GOVERNMENT ownership clips) pixel ~37% (64-row x ~39-col dense F/M/T grid, so pixel-diff is dominated by thousands of tiny Liberation digits). Wide F/M/T triplet grid, summary+%PASS+TOTAL, ward+ownership, C/RANK & R/RANK, rows align to original within <1pt (row01 y=144.2 both).
- council-top-10-schools (3pp): 6-7 true word-miss/page (S/NO./COMPETENCY/LEVEL header tokenisation + 1 long school-name clip) pixel ~20%. 6 stacked top-10 division-grid sections incl DISTRICTWISE/government/'TEN LOOSER' (original 'GORVENMENT' misspelling preserved), C/RANK only. Note GPA in the PRIVATE sections carries a trailing zero ('1.44180') vs '1.4418' elsewhere - captured verbatim.
- council-best-students-overall (5pp): total 10 true word-miss across ALL 5 pages (ends of the longest DETAILED SUBJECTS free-text strings) pixel ~9-21%. 9 stacked top-10 sections (OVERALL/FEMALE/MALE x councilwise/government/private); pale-cyan banner on section 1, cream C/NO column, empty position-10 row reproduced; DETAILED SUBJECTS free-text preserved exactly.
- council-best-students-subjectwise (30pp): content pages 1-20 total ~18 true word-miss (per-page vertical 'POSITION' header + 2 long-school clips) pixel ~9-14%; trailing blank pages 21-30 are 0.00% pixel / 0-0 words EXACT. 20 subject sections (top-10 each) + 10 reproduced blank pages; ministry header only on page 1 (continuation pages carry just the subject title, matching the original); COMPETENCY background from GRADE letter.

NOTE for FEAT-004 (region): region school-rank / subjects-rank / top-10 / best-students pairs share these exact structures - COPY the corresponding council template+CSS as a starting point (do NOT link) and add the region's extra COUNCIL column + R/RANK where noted. WeasyPrint gotchas reconfirmed: pass ONE FontConfiguration() to write_pdf (already wired) or fonts fall back to Noto; set thead{display:table-row-group} so headers are not repeated on continuation pages; give the C/NO / school / competency / detailed columns a slightly smaller font (5.9-7pt) + tiny negative letter-spacing so long strings do not clip; reproduce trailing blank source pages with an empty page-break div for exact page count.
